slides.title: The April 2026 AGM approved the strategy to 2030, with a vision to 2045
rows: Scale, strength and green anchor the strategy to 2030
The April 2026 AGM approved the strategy to 2030, with a vision to 2045
• Maintain a leading position in Vietnam in terms of scale and rank among Asia’s Top 100 banks, expand international presence.
Comprehensively transform and continue to lead in retail, SME, and FDI customer segments.
• Become a financial institution with a fully integrated ecosystem by 2045, serving customers seamlessly across all platforms and
channels, supported by an extensive international network.
• Optimize business mix to strengthen capital adequacy, liquidity, operating efficiency and sustainable development in alignment with
leading international standards and best practices.
• Lead innovation, technology, and digital transformation in Vietnam, with comprehensive AI adoption.
• Strengthen risk management capabilities; develop high-quality human resources and modern service/product offerings.
• Promote corporate culture, innovation culture, and governance excellence, aiming to become one of Asia’s leading financial institutions
in terms of operational efficiency and modern governance by 2045.
• Position BIDV as Vietnam’s leading bank in green, sustainable development and ESG practices.
• Lead the market in green credit and sustainable finance, contributing positively to the country’s economic, social, and environmental
